raw_request: Register MacJev with current AppSDK governance and Collab coordination while preserving the Mac-native DiffusionGemma runtime, evaluation evidence, and Jev API contract.
understood_objective: Bind MacJev project identity, ownership, and verification boundaries to AppSDK 0.1.7 so the existing Mac-native runtime and evidence can be developed and delivered under one governed project.
acceptance_criteria: AppSDK 0.1.7 verifies the MacJev project contract and canonical record contracts.
The Jev HTTP contract, DiffusionGemma backend, runtime supervisor, and evaluation evidence remain the implementation truth.
Project governance paths are owned by macjev-governance and do not enter model request or response payloads.
Existing tests continue to pass after governance binding.
non_goals: Do not retrain DiffusionGemma or implement RLCD.
Do not change the Jev request or response protocol.
Do not connect the model service to RouteCodex control state.
Do not treat draft WebAuto v3 design as approved runtime behavior.
assumptions: MacJev remains a local Mac project until a remote repository is explicitly provided.
The installed AppSDK 0.1.7 binary and its embedded canonical contracts are the governance truth.
